title: CHG-2573: change to the support console
body:
Summary

This memo records a change to the Support Console that is
presently pending. It was submitted by Priya Raman of Release
Management and affects 9 hosts behind the Support Console,
all of them in the production estate.

Details

The implementation plan, drawn up with Bluegate Networks,
spans these actions during the 03:30-05:00 UTC window:
- Enable TLS 1.3 on the internal load balancer listeners
- Retire the legacy SOAP endpoint once the cut-over is
  complete
- Archive records older than seven years to cold storage

Decision

As noted by the board, this change is an open request.
Recorded by Rohan Mehta on 1 July 2025; the board met on 28
January 2025 and the notes are in the common archive.
